tasks.subject: Task 3: Label<->FolderPath mapping (nested labels, system-label special cases)
tasks.description:

Create: src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail.Tests/GmailLabelMapperTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**

tasks.subject: Task 5: Error normalization (Gmail HTTP/quota -> stable errorSignature)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement `GmailErrorNormalizer.Normalize(Exception)` producing a stable `gmail:<status>:<reason>` signature (CONTRACTS section 8) for catalog matching -- mapping 429/rateLimitExceeded/userRateLimitExceeded/quotaExceeded, 403, 401, 404, 5xx -- without leaking the impersonated mailbox or SA identity.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail/GmailErrorNormalizer.cs
Create: src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail.Tests/GmailErrorNormalizerTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- 429 + rateLimitExceeded -> 'gmail:429:rateLimitExceeded'.
- quotaExceeded -> 'gmail:<status>:quotaExceeded'.
- 401 -> 'gmail:401:authError'; 404 -> 'gmail:404:notFound'.
- Unknown/non-Google exception -> 'gmail:unknown'.
- Signature contains no '@' / email even when the source message embeds the mailbox.
- TryParseRetryAfter parses a numeric Retry-After header to a TimeSpan and returns null for missing/invalid/negative values.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~GmailErrorNormalizerTests` -> all pass.

tasks.subject: Task 13: Security Verification (userGate)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the Gmail connector's security focus: the service-account JSON key is never logged and held only transiently; DWD impersonation uses the minimal https://mail.google.com/ scope only; the raw key is never written to disk; quota/auth errors never leak the SA identity or impersonated mailbox to end users.

**USER-ORDERED GATE -- NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail.Tests/GmailSecurityVerificationTests.cs
Create: src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail.Tests/RecordingTextWriter.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Minimal scope: GmailServiceFactory.RequiredScopes equals exactly ['https://mail.google.com/'] (no gmail.readonly/gmail.modify/drive/calendar) -- asserted by test.
- Key never on disk: building a service creates zero new files under temp and cwd (before/after diff 0) -- asserted by test.
- Key not exposed publicly: reflection over GmailConnectionConfig public members finds no member returning the SA JSON / private-key PEM -- asserted by test (no public string property contains 'PRIVATE KEY').
- No SA identity / mailbox in error surface: for 403 quotaExceeded and 401 authError whose raw message embeds victim@example.com and the SA email, the normalized signature contains neither '@' nor 'victim' nor 'gserviceaccount' -- asserted, signatures captured.
- No credential in any provider-emitted log/exception text: a RecordingTextWriter installed as Console.Out/Error during a forced TestConnectionAsync 401 failure (fixture carrying SA email + mailbox) captures zero occurrences of the SA email, mailbox, or 'PRIVATE KEY' -- asserted on the captured buffer.
- TLS enforced / no arbitrary-host exfiltration: the production GmailService built by GmailServiceFactory.Create(config) has a BaseUri with scheme 'https' and host 'gmail.googleapis.com' (endpoint pinned; caller input cannot redirect or downgrade traffic) -- asserted by test.
- DWD justification documented: docs/connectors/gmail-testing.md contains the scope justification (re-checked here, phrase 'least privilege').

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~GmailSecurityVerificationTests` -> all pass (capture and retain console output as gate evidence).
